tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.outcome: Size-S Bulldog tee (CC-TEE-WHITE) was out of stock and the reprint was blocked by open invoice #501. The team prepared the $840 invoice payment; after human approval it was paid, clearing the invoice so Bulldog Print Co's 5-day reprint can ship.

agent_contributions.boss: Read the ticket and delegated in parallel to Inventory, Accounting, and Customer Service.
agent_contributions.inventory: Confirmed size-S stock = 0, checked the vendor (Bulldog Print Co can_ship = false while #501 is open), drafted a vendor order, and delegated to Accounting to clear the blocking invoice.
agent_contributions.accounting: Listed open invoices and checked cash, identified invoice #501 ($840) as the blocker, and updated the ticket. Did not pay on its own; left it for human approval.
agent_contributions.customer_service: Drafted a customer reply (not sent) and delegated to Inventory to confirm stock and reprint timing.

tickets.subject: Rent due
tickets.outcome: Rent of $2,400 on lease #1 (Chapel Street shop) was due 2026-09-02. The team prepared the payment; after human approval the rent was paid and next_due advanced to 2026-10-02.

agent_contributions.boss: Read the ticket and delegated to Facilities.
agent_contributions.facilities: Confirmed lease #1 (rent $2,400, next due 2026-09-02) and delegated the payment to Accounting.
agent_contributions.accounting: Checked cash and updated the ticket, preparing the rent payment. Did not pay on its own; left it for human approval.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: Yale AI Club requested 20 size-M navy hoodies (CC-HOOD-NAVY) at a bulk discount; only 8 in stock (short 12). The team computed margin from cost $22 / list $58, proposed a discount that stays above cost, and drafted a customer reply. After human approval of the discount, the ticket resolved with no cash movement.

agent_contributions.boss: Read the ticket and delegated to Customer Service.
agent_contributions.customer_service: Owned the discount decision, delegated to Inventory and Accounting, drafted a customer reply (not sent), and updated the ticket.
agent_contributions.inventory: Confirmed size-M stock = 8 against the requested 20 (short 12).
agent_contributions.accounting: Checked pricing (cost $22 / list $58) to bound the discount above cost, and updated the ticket.
